summary: Introduced Clubs/Communities as a social layer in NoriJjak. Implemented club models, membership management with roles, and integration with the Games domain. Users can now discover, join, and create clubs, and host games associated with their clubs.

environment_readiness.infra_evidence: PostgreSQL and Redis containers are healthy.

major_decisions.decision: Implemented roles (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER) and statuses (REQUESTED, APPROVED).
major_decisions.reason: Allows for moderation and community management essential for GA-grade social features.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Increased complexity in membership logic and permissions.

major_decisions.decision: Enforced that only approved members can create games for a club.
major_decisions.reason: Prevents spam and ensures club-hosted games are legitimate.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Adds a check on game creation.

major_decisions.decision: Implemented Clubs list and detail on both Web and Mobile, with creation on Web.
major_decisions.reason: Prioritizes discovery across platforms while keeping complex forms on Web for the initial implementation.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Club creation deferred for Mobile in this step.

tests.name: Clubs API tests
tests.notes: Verified creation, listing, detail, and joining.

tests.name: Game-Club Integration test
tests.notes: Verified club-hosted game creation and detail retrieval.

tests.name: All quality gates
tests.notes: 25 API tests and all frontend smoke tests pass.
